source: The game's battle code: RpgStateUtils.TransformSumsToFinalStats, SkillSpeedRatingToSpeedFactorPct, SkillRecoveryRatingToPct; skill configs (HeroData).

speedFactors.skillSpeed: factor = 1 + (SkillSpeedFactorPct(Skill Speed rating) + Skill Speed buffs %) / 100, not below 0
speedFactors.comboSpeed: factor = 1 + (SkillSpeedFactorPct(Combo Speed rating) + Combo Speed buffs %) / 100: Combo Speed uses the SAME curve as Skill Speed (stat_curves.json SkillSpeedFactorPct)
speedFactors.skillRecovery: cooldown timers tick down by frameTime x recoveryFactor each update (UpdateCharacterCooldownsSystem), so effective cooldown = base cooldown / recoveryFactor, recoveryFactor = 1 + (SkillRecoveryPct(rating) + Skill Recovery buffs %) / 100

cooldowns.values: skills.json cooldown (seconds); Ultimate 15 s plus its mana cost
cooldowns.canBeReduced: each skill config has CanCooldownBeReduced (true for normal skills and Ultimates); Skill Recovery and cooldown-reduction effects only act on those
cooldowns.pveStart: skills start ready unless their config sets ShouldStartFromCooldown / StartCooldownTime (all 0 for hero skills in this export)
cooldowns.blocked: timers are skipped while the character's skills are blocked (RpgStateUtils.IsBlocked check in the cooldown update)

comboTiming: Combo timing is the same for every Invoker in play (see combos.json note); comboSpeed scales it.
unconfirmed: How the speed factor is applied: read as a speed multiplier (animation time / factor); the code that consumes it is a component value not decoded yet.
Auto-battle skill order (AI rules in each skill config's AiRules / TargetPriority) is not exported yet.
recoveryFactor is assumed to be built like the speed factors (1 + pct/100); the tick itself (time x factor) is read from the code.
